description: Source code for a custom Android ListView named ExpandingListView that allows list items (cells) to expand or collapse revealing or hiding extra content with smooth animations. The class manages user interactions, animations, and drawing of off-screen views during transitions.

classes.name: ExpandingListView
classes.description: A custom ListView supporting expandable and collapsible list items with animated transitions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the list view, setting up the item click listener.

methods.name: expandView
methods.description: Expands a clicked list item with accompanying animations and manages layout adjustments.

methods.name: collapseView
methods.description: Collapses an expanded list item with animations to hide extra content.

methods.name: getAnimation
methods.description: Creates an Animator for changing the top and bottom bounds of a view.
